title: Re-run shows what moved: name the pool drift and diff the lead and ranks
deviations_from_card: Cases: the card's 8 plus 4 (poolChange agrees with poolDrift's count; ids without a parallel label list give null rather than an invented name; a lead swap where either run's leadSeparation is 'overlapping' reports reason 'within_band' - the coordinator's binding confidence-band rule, which the card did not case; capNames list cap). Case 5 was strengthened: moves are ranks WITHIN the common members, so prev [A,B,C] vs next [A,D,B] yields no move for B. LeadChange carries fromId/toId beside the labels, and the delta also returns `common` and `mode` for the strip. poolChange lives in groupEvalDelta.ts (the card's write set), not inside groupEvalOpenMachine.ts beside poolDrift as the slot-A note suggested; a test pins that the two agree, and the delta module imports nothing from the machine. MODE_LABEL_KEY in GroupEvalNotices.tsx is now exported for the strip. Held previous comparison is keyed by roleKey (never diffs two roles) and a Re-run from a failed run keeps the last comparison that landed. Added outside the write set (shared surface under the lock): perf-budget.json app/page.tsx 1385/8681 -> 1387/8694 for this card's measured share (+2 modules / 12761 bytes). Commit order: catalogs, test+pure module, doc, feat, perf.
